name: Marine Science Investigations at the Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College and Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
what_you_do: A week of hands on sea science on Coconut Island. You do reef surveys in the water, island walking tours and lab work on sea sounds, brains and reef life.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 and recent graduates. 24 spots.
duration: One week (2026: June 1 to 5), with a boat from Heeia Kea Boat Harbor to Coconut Island each day, weather permitting
deadline_text: 2026 application opened in March for the June 1 to 5 program. 2027 not posted. Email summer.programs@hawaii.edu to get notified.
how_to_apply: Use the application form on the Outreach College program page. Contact summer.programs@hawaii.edu or 808-956-9246.
notes: The cost is lower for Hawaii residents. Programs on Coconut Island run if the weather allows.
